body.message:
Hi, I’m currently in Dubai for the next few days and looking for a furnished apartment for an upcoming stay.

I’m considering both a 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartment, for approximately 1 to 3 months, and I’m currently comparing different areas and properties in Dubai.

Could you please send me:

• Available 1BR and 2BR options
• Monthly rate for 1 month, 2 months and 3 months
• What is included in the rate (utilities, Wi-Fi, housekeeping, parking, etc.)
• Any long-stay discount available for a 2- or 3-month stay
• Photos and exact location/building name

I’m currently in Dubai for the next few days and would like to view the property in person while I’m here, so please also let me know what units I can arrange to see.

Thank you,
Dalal
